ingame_enable.name: In-game enable/disable
ingame_enable.description:
Allows you to enable and disable Bismuth while playing by pressing F8. It also allows you to use Difference Mode by pressing F9 (Difference Mode is very unstable).

 WARNING: This option effectively removes any optimization.

ios_gpu_debug.name: iOS GPU debug overlay
ios_gpu_debug.description: Shows an on-screen iOS diagnostic that verifies Bismuth is submitting its OpenGL ES GPU draw path with the shader and texture-backed object/group/color state. Debug only; enabling it adds a small amount of diagnostic overhead.
